build_schedule_construct_schedule: build a learning rate schedule using construct_schedule with name, dataset_size, total_steps, and mode arguments
create_piecewise_interpolated_schedule: create a piecewise interpolated schedule with vals, boundaries, and linear or cosine interpolation type
create_cosine_schedule: create a cosine decay schedule with count, total steps, peak value, and optional end value
create_polynomial_schedule: create a polynomial decay schedule with start, total, init_value, end_value, and power parameters
create_inverse_time_decay_schedule: create an inverse time decay schedule with start, total, init_value, end_value, and power options
